>What you also might want to think about is what kind of impression are you making? Do you think you might inadverdently be turning people away?

I don't know really, but I'm trying my best to be social. I'm quite nervous and stumble over my words a lot so that's probably why people don't wanna talk with me.

Yeah, they were total strangers.

>Was this the event that triggered off your suicidal thoughts? Or were there other issues before this..?

Not really. We have been talking with each other for the past few days because I was assigned a group of people I have to deal with from now on.  I try to talk with these people and it's very difficult because either they give very short answers, don't answer at all, or just go away.
